# Webloo

> Webloo is a US and Morocco based growth ecosystem of four business units: Webloo Digital, Webloo Sports, Webloo Retail and Webloo Experiences. More than 250 experts work as one team, so a brand, federation or league can go from strategy to platform, store, media and live event without changing partners.

Webloo's promise is "No hand-offs": one partner and one team from brand to stadium, instead of a brief passed between five agencies.

## Business units
Webloo Digital builds brands, platforms and media campaigns. Webloo Sports grows commercial revenue for federations, leagues and clubs, and activates sponsorships. Webloo Retail builds and runs official stores and licensed merchandise. Webloo Experiences produces film, content, live events, fan zones and brand activations.

## Offices

- Miami, Florida: 777 Brickell Avenue, Miami, FL 33131, USA
- Rabat, Morocco: 2 Bis Mernissa, Rabat
- Skopje, North Macedonia: Vasil Gjorgov 20A, Kapishtec, Skopje 1000

## Selected work
- Basketball Africa League · NBA × FIBA: A new tournament, sold out in Morocco. Campaign in Arabic, French and English, paid and influencer media, TV, radio and billboards, sales funnel and group sales. Result: 91% sell-through in 12 weeks. Units: Digital, Sports, Experiences.
- CAF · AFCON 2025: The official logo reveal film, from casting to soundtrack, in two weeks. Creative direction, casting, art direction, VFX, animation and an original soundtrack. Units: Experiences, Digital.
- Haier Europe: A brand new to football, activated at the top level. National team content, PR and outdoor that put a new sponsor on the map. Units: Sports, Experiences.
- duPont Registry: Where luxury cars are traded with confidence, rebuilt as a modern marketplace. Platform redesign and growth marketing for the luxury car marketplace. Units: Digital.
- Miami Concours: Paid social and content for Miami's premier automotive event. Paid social, social media management and content strategy, delivered in six weeks. Units: Digital, Experiences.
- Rabat Live Arena: Morocco's biggest stage: the match, the music, the roar. Brand, campaign, ticketing and live production for concerts and match nights. Units: Experiences, Sports, Digital.
- Retromobile: The 50th anniversary edition, from identity to digital presence. Anniversary identity, campaign and digital presence. Units: Digital, Experiences.
- Catalyst Health Group: A patient-first platform for a physician network. Patient-first website and growth marketing for a physician network. Units: Digital.
- Wydad Athletic Club: Together Forever: a club identity built for its supporters. Club campaign and identity built with and for its supporters. Units: Sports, Digital.
- FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup · Morocco 2025: Bringing a world cup to fans across Morocco. Fan engagement and content around a world cup hosted in Morocco. Units: Sports, Experiences.

## Questions and answers
### What is Webloo?
Webloo is a US and Morocco based growth ecosystem of four business units: Webloo Digital, Webloo Sports, Webloo Retail and Webloo Experiences. More than 250 experts work as one team, so a brand, federation or league can go from strategy to platform, store, media and live event without changing partners.

### What do Webloo's four business units do?
Webloo Digital builds brands, platforms and media campaigns. Webloo Sports grows commercial revenue for federations, leagues and clubs, and activates sponsorships. Webloo Retail builds and runs official stores and licensed merchandise. Webloo Experiences produces film, content, live events, fan zones and brand activations.

### Where is Webloo based?
Webloo has offices in Newport Beach (California), Miami (Florida), Rabat (Morocco) and Skopje (North Macedonia), serving clients in North America, Africa, the Middle East and Europe.

### Who has Webloo worked with?
Clients include the Royal Moroccan Football Federation (FRMF), the Confederation of African Football (CAF), the Basketball Africa League (BAL), Haier Europe, Rabat Live Arena, Wydad Athletic Club, Miami Concours, duPont Registry, Retromobile and Catalyst Health Group.

### How do I start a project with Webloo?
Tell us the outcome you need at hello@webloo.com or through Start a project. We put together the right business units and connect you with a team within one business day.

## How engagements work
- Scope of work: a defined deliverable, timeline and price.
- Time and materials: specialists billed by the day for advisory and surge capacity.
- Partnership: for the right project Webloo co-invests, builds and operates alongside the client, and is paid from the results rather than a fee.
- Budgets start under $25K and go above $250K; a 60-second brief gets a reply within one business day.
- A 30-minute intro call (Google Meet) can be booked from the assistant on the page or at https://meetings.hubspot.com/mehdi-naourass/webloo

## Careers
Webloo hires across its four units: design, engineering and media (Digital); partnerships, sponsorship and fan engagement (Sports); e-commerce, merchandise and operations (Retail); production, film and live events (Experiences). Send a CV to hello@webloo.com with the subject "Careers".

## Webloo Loop
Webloo Loop is how Webloo Digital plans, produces, launches and learns in one continuous cycle: brief, plan, produce, launch, learn. Human-led, powered by AI.
